# Unified web skin v2 -- coverage manifest.
#
# Three directives:
#   allow-dynamic <prefix>   runtime-composed class attribute, attributed by
#                            str_starts_with against the source fragment; min 3
#                            chars (see skin_v2_class_vocabulary_test.php)
#   require-class <name>     a class only ever emitted at runtime, so the
#                            extractor cannot see it -- but it still must be
#                            styled by leikwan-v2.css
#   route <verdict> <path>   page coverage during cutover (see
#                            skin_v2_coverage_manifest_test.php, a later task)
#
# Verdicts: verified | pending | not-a-page

# --- allow-dynamic: runtime-composed class attributes -----------------------
#
# Every one of the 17 runtime-composed attributes in the nine sources is a
# concatenation whose static prefix comes first, e.g.
#   class="badge ' . $statusClass . '"   ->  badge
# Matching is anchored, so an entry can only attribute an attribute that starts
# with it -- it cannot reach across to an unrelated one.
allow-dynamic badge
allow-dynamic flash
allow-dynamic nav-link
allow-dynamic pg-view-tab
allow-dynamic pg-page-body
allow-dynamic kb-thread-card
#
# These two attributes have no static class text at all -- the whole value is a
# PHP expression -- so the anchored prefix is the expression itself. Anything
# they emit that appears nowhere statically is listed under require-class below.
allow-dynamic ' . $this->escape($class)
allow-dynamic ' . implode(' ', $classes)

# --- require-class: emitted only at runtime ---------------------------------
#
# Read off the PHP behind each allow-dynamic attribute above. Every other value
# those attributes can produce (success / danger / info from the badge and flash
# ternaries and matches; button / ghost / secondary from renderCommandLink and
# renderCopyButton, which no caller ever overrides; usage-day from the calendar)
# already appears in a static class attribute, so the extractor sees it. These
# six do not appear anywhere statically and would otherwise go unstyled.
#
# The state modifier shared by the three tab/nav/card conditionals:
#   PrecisionGridUi.php:24  class="nav-link' . ($active ? ' active' : '') . '"
#   PrecisionGridUi.php:79  class="pg-view-tab' . ($selected ? ' active' : '')"
#   AuthController.php:225  class="kb-thread-card' . ($isActive ? ' active' : '')"
require-class active
#
# BaseController.php:873-880 -- usage calendar day cells build their class list
# in a PHP array, so only the "usage-day is-empty" branch is visible statically.
require-class has-usage
require-class is-today
#
# BaseController.php:1329-1335 -- the page-body template modifier, chosen from
# the page title. Never written literally in a class attribute.
require-class pg-template-overview
require-class pg-template-detail
require-class pg-template-operations

# --- route: page coverage manifest (see skin_v2_coverage_manifest_test.php) --
#
# Verdicts: verified | pending | not-a-page
#
# verified   = v2 shell ships the route; reviewed and passes
# pending    = still needs work before LEIKWAN_SKIN=v2 can be the default
# not-a-page = API endpoint, artifact download, redirect-only, or POST target
#
